name: Kozakura Yui
source:
Arcane Card: Rosepink of WANDs

A second-year student popular among her peers for being beautiful and fashionable.

She has a cheerful and lively personality, has many friends, and is the mood maker of the Twilight Club. She's also very athletic and often been asked to help out in the athletic clubs. One of her few flaw is that she's a bit wicked.

She gets along well with the protagonist, Tomori, and respect him as her senpai. Blessed with great health and a body too well-developed for her own good, it's unknown whether the abundance of her unconscious skinships with Tomori is a sly act or because it was just part of her natural personality.

She loves to talk about love, and when people talk about it, she can't help but listen to them. She wonders if that kind of intrusion will help her someday. As if impatient for love, nowadays she's reading romance novels and indulging herself in fleeting delusions.

"You see, I'm a beautiful and reliable junior, but sometimes I can be a bit ditzy, can't I?"

[Edited from [url=http://nanawind.jp/product/prj06/chapter1/]Official Website[/url]]
